why: Letters are right (havāmahe 'vaspartar); only the accent pair म॒हे ऽव॑ is odd for an unaccented verb + mid-pada vocative, possibly the edition's rendering of the elided a; not clearly mistyped.
somapāḥ is the correct vocative 'soma-drinker'; metre and sense fine.
indavaḥ 'drops' is the right nominative plural; sense and metre fine.
iryeva (iryā iva) is a genuine rare word matching the simile series of the verse.
śatasya nṛṇām 'of a hundred men' is correct; ṛtasya would not fit.
jīvo mṛtasya 'the living (moves) of the dead' is the known sense; correct.
haviṣaḥ kṛtasya 'of the oblation prepared' is correct.
dūtasya jagmuṣaḥ 'of the messenger who has gone' is correct.
stutasya 'of the praise(d)' fits the sentence; correct.
rātasya 'of the given (mead)' agreeing with madhvaḥ; correct.
tritasya is the name Trita, confirmed by the next verse; correct.
ṛtava ṛtubhiḥ 'the seasons with the seasons' is correct sandhi (ṛtavaḥ + ṛ).
rutasya 'of the broken/injured' in the list of patients; correct.
dhūtasya 'of the (soma) shaken in the waters' is correct.
bhūtasya jātaḥ patiḥ is the well-known reading; correct.
papivān tsutasya is the edition's n+s → nts sandhi style, as elsewhere in the file.
ayaṃ sutas tasya pibā: two words sutaḥ + tasya joined by sandhi; correct.
sutayo va ūtayaḥ 'your aids are easy of passage'; correct rare word.
sukṛtasya loke 'in the world of good deeds' is correct.
tiro ravam 'beyond the roar' is correct; havam would not fit.
sudevaḥ 'with good gods' is a correct compound; metre fine.
jīvitā 'life' (anūcīnā jīvitā) is correct.
dravitā 'runner' (na dravitā) is a correct agent noun.
prāvitā 'furtherer' (pra+avitā) is correct.
sudevaṃ 'very divine' is correct; metre fine.
suvrataṃ 'of good vows' is a correct compound.
devāś ca in the list with ca after each item; correct.
sujātaṃ 'well-born' is correct.
māmahe (perfect of mah-) 'has granted' is correct; metre fine.
devena manasā 'with divine mind' is correct.
nir ayā (ayā, subjunctive of i-) 'I will go out' is correct.
deveṣo = deva iṣo in sandhi; correct.
devṛṣu 'among the brothers-in-law' is the correct locative of devṛ.
vidan no = vidat naḥ in sandhi; correct.
vidatha ukthaśāsā is the Vedic hiatus sandhi of vidathe + u; correct.
sanitā 'winner' is correct and the play on sanitā sanaye is intended.
ūtayo (ūtayaḥ) before a voiced sound; correct.
pra bhūtam 'be forward' is correct; metre fine.
sātaya utaidhi is the Vedic sandhi of sātaye + u; correct.
srutayaḥ 'streams' is correct.

suggest: मो षु व॑रुण मृ॒न्मयं॑ गृ॒हं रा॑जन्न॒हं ग॑मम् । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑ ॥
why: First pada has only 6 syllables for gāyatrī and begins with a svarita mark that needs a preceding udatta, so the opening words (mo ṣu) were dropped; check the accents of the restored words.
sant satā is the edition's n+s → nts sandhi, as in 2.11.10; correct.
saṃ jitam 'win' is correct.
apa durmatiṃ hatam 'strike away ill-will' is correct.
svapnena tamasā 'by sleep, by darkness' is correct.
ahaṃ so asmi 'I am he' is correct.
devādhā = deva adhā in sandhi; correct.
devācyā 'turned toward the gods' is correct.
vy asya 'poured out' is correct.
dāśuṣaḥ sve sadhasthe 'in the worshipper's own seat' is correct.
aśyāṃ 'may I attain' (optative) is correct.
uta smāsya = uta sma asya in sandhi; correct.
aśvyasya 'of horses' parallel to rathyasya; correct.
vy aryamā (vi ceti) is correct.
arta (aorist of ṛ-) 'rose' is correct.
try aryamā (trī + aryamā) is correct.
athopa = atha upa in sandhi; correct.
prāsmāṁ ava 'help us' is correct.
mṛgo asyā dantaḥ 'its tooth' (asyāḥ) is correct.
maho arbhasya 'of great and small' is correct.
